frontend: Wood lexer, parser, project/module loader, binding, signatures and integrated body analysis
backend: Wood-written C++23 emitter using the existing native C++ runtime
lock_policy: compiler CLI verifies existing project wood.lock automatically; --locked requires it; raw frontend/body inspection APIs remain unverified

declarations: records and methods, generic or monomorphic
extern C ABI declarations with scalar, byte-string, scalar callback and numeric-buffer parameters
calls: owned capturing closures and local functions
stateful rooted calls with post-argument revalidation
inference: contextual generic function values and deferred arguments
callable signature patterns and Result projections
associated Result/Item materialization in call hints and constraints
supported.comprehensions: list/dictionary results; source-ordered for/if clauses; list/string/dictionary snapshots and ranges; private binding scopes; contextual result types; generic instances
supported.native_primitives: native_calls.fixed and native_calls.polymorphic; complete known-name vocabulary verified against production
supported.closures: owned immutable captures by default; explicit mutable owned copies; transitive lexical capture; contextual parameters; local defaults/keywords and inferred results
supported.iteration: native list/array/string/dictionary/range cursors; record iter/next protocols including inferred methods; Step presence distinct from None; owned cursor snapshots; arrays flatten logical row-major order; existing std.iter adapters
supported.numerical: all existing array primitives and scalar math helpers; checked shape/index arithmetic, numeric promotion, snapshot views and native kernels; std.num/std.linalg/std.geometry
supported.native_ffi: existing C ABI; scalar results; scalar, borrowed bytes, scalar function-pointer and contiguous numeric-buffer parameters; rooted mutable buffers; shared callback failure guards; cross-module ABI validation
supported.native_services: Existing SQLite, TCP/HTTP, TLS/HTTPS and joinable raw-function tasks; all six native resource scopes; source-located native arguments and production evaluation/diagnostic order

not_supported: complete production-language/driver compatibility and release-promotion gate (normal driver commands are implemented separately; see driver-contract.json)
ownership: existing checked value/snapshot semantics; string index/slice and builtin len/slice borrow only through nonescaping reads with side-effect-free later index/bound expressions; effectful cases retain snapshots; other reads conservative; evaluated owned arguments transferred into value parameters; rooted mutations revalidated after effectful arguments; immutable rooted closures with nontrivial captures borrow for passive arguments only; mutable callable paths validate each index before arguments and reacquire afterwards
string_read_borrowing: checked string operations only; fail-closed expression-family whitelist excludes calls, invocations and comprehensions in later indices/bounds; tuple selections and member paths through them own their selected value to avoid dangling std::get references; other owned temporaries retain full-expression lifetimes; no public references or string views
array_ownership: checked index reads borrow for passive indices with safe base lifetimes and snapshot for effectful indices; tuple selections and member paths through them own their selected array before reads; final top-level array returns may consume once-used owned array locals/value parameters; captures, mutable foreign borrows, closure/comprehension return subtrees and local error handlers are excluded; mutable C ABI paths validate before arguments and reacquire afterwards

checked_ir.indices: module-local syntax indices, global declaration indices and semantic pool IDs are separate
facts: resolved calls and source-ordered arguments with parameter mappings
canonical concrete record types keyed by symbol

checked_ir.errors: located diagnostics; rejected result exports no partial program
checked_ir.preconditions: owned parser/loader-produced valid acyclic arenas; callers preserve input invariants

expression_integration: opt-in resumable Checker requests for body-dependent operations; prior isolated Checker behavior remains the default
